JmapDate.description: An ISO 8601 date-time string in UTC (RFC 8620 §1.4).

EmailHeader.description: A single raw message header field (RFC 8621 §4.1.3). Ordering is preserved.

value.description: Header field value (decoded, with folding whitespace collapsed).

Keywords.description: Map of IMAP keyword → true. The presence of a key means the keyword is set (RFC 8621 §4.1.1).

Mailbox.description: A JMAP Mailbox object (RFC 8621 §3). Represents a folder or label used to organise emails.

accountId.description: The account this mailbox belongs to (server-set).

role.description: System role (inbox, trash, drafts, etc.), or null for user-created mailboxes.

parentId.description: Id of the parent mailbox, or null if top-level.

sortOrder.description: Client sort-order hint; lower values sort first.

deletable.description: Whether the user may delete this mailbox (server-set).

totalEmails.description: Total number of emails in the mailbox (server-set).

unreadEmails.description: Number of emails without the \Seen keyword (server-set).

totalThreads.description: Total number of threads with at least one email in this mailbox, or null if not supported (server-set).

unreadThreads.description: Number of threads with at least one unread email in this mailbox, or null if not supported (server-set).

MailboxBase.description: Base Mailbox shape used as the allOf anchor for MailboxExt (allows vendor-prefixed properties).

accountId.description: The account this mailbox belongs to (server-set).

role.description: System role (inbox, trash, drafts, etc.), or null for user-created mailboxes.

parentId.description: Id of the parent mailbox, or null if top-level.

sortOrder.description: Client sort-order hint; lower values sort first.

deletable.description: Whether the user may delete this mailbox (server-set).

totalEmails.description: Total number of emails in the mailbox (server-set).

unreadEmails.description: Number of emails without the \Seen keyword (server-set).

totalThreads.description: Total number of threads with at least one email in this mailbox, or null if not supported (server-set).

unreadThreads.description: Number of threads with at least one unread email in this mailbox, or null if not supported (server-set).

Email.description: A JMAP Email object (RFC 8621 §4). Represents a single RFC 5322 message.

blobId.description: Blob id of the raw RFC 5322 message (server-set).

mailboxIds.description: Id[Boolean] map — MailboxId → true means the email is in that mailbox (RFC 8621 §4.1.1).

keywords.description: IMAP keywords set on this email.

size.description: Size in bytes of the raw RFC 5322 message (server-set).

receivedAt.description: Date/time the message was received by the server.

subject.description: Decoded Subject header value, or null if absent.

messageId.description: Array of Message-ID values (RFC 8621 §4.1.3), or null if absent.

inReplyTo.description: Array of In-Reply-To values (RFC 8621 §4.1.3), or null if absent.

references.description: Array of References values (RFC 8621 §4.1.3), or null if absent.

sender.description: Sender header addresses (RFC 8621 §4.1.2.3), or null if absent.

from.description: From header addresses (RFC 8621 §4.1.2.3), or null if absent.

to.description: To header addresses (RFC 8621 §4.1.2.3), or null if absent.

cc.description: Cc header addresses (RFC 8621 §4.1.2.3), or null if absent.

bcc.description: Bcc header addresses (RFC 8621 §4.1.2.3), or null if absent.

replyTo.description: Reply-To header addresses (RFC 8621 §4.1.2.3), or null if absent.

preview.description: Plain-text excerpt of the message body (at most 256 characters, server-set).

hasAttachment.description: True if the message has at least one attachment (server-set).

headers.description: Ordered list of all raw message header fields (RFC 8621 §4.1.3).

EmailBase.description: Base Email shape used as the allOf anchor for EmailExt (allows vendor-prefixed properties).

blobId.description: Blob id of the raw RFC 5322 message (server-set).

mailboxIds.description: Id[Boolean] map — MailboxId → true means the email is in that mailbox (RFC 8621 §4.1.1).

keywords.description: IMAP keywords set on this email.

size.description: Size in bytes of the raw RFC 5322 message (server-set).

receivedAt.description: Date/time the message was received by the server.

subject.description: Decoded Subject header value, or null if absent.

messageId.description: Array of Message-ID values (RFC 8621 §4.1.3), or null if absent.

inReplyTo.description: Array of In-Reply-To values (RFC 8621 §4.1.3), or null if absent.

references.description: Array of References values (RFC 8621 §4.1.3), or null if absent.

sender.description: Sender header addresses (RFC 8621 §4.1.2.3), or null if absent.

from.description: From header addresses (RFC 8621 §4.1.2.3), or null if absent.

to.description: To header addresses (RFC 8621 §4.1.2.3), or null if absent.

cc.description: Cc header addresses (RFC 8621 §4.1.2.3), or null if absent.

bcc.description: Bcc header addresses (RFC 8621 §4.1.2.3), or null if absent.

replyTo.description: Reply-To header addresses (RFC 8621 §4.1.2.3), or null if absent.

preview.description: Plain-text excerpt of the message body (at most 256 characters, server-set).

hasAttachment.description: True if the message has at least one attachment (server-set).

headers.description: Ordered list of all raw message header fields (RFC 8621 §4.1.3).

CreationId.description: Client-assigned temporary id used within a single /set or /import call.

SetError.description: Describes why a create, update or destroy operation failed (RFC 8620 §5.3).

PatchObject.description: JMAP PatchObject (RFC 8620 §5.3): keys are JSON Pointers (e.g. /name); values are replacement values or null to remove.

Thread.description: A JMAP Thread object (RFC 8621 §2). Groups related Email objects.

emailIds.description: Ordered list of email ids in this thread, oldest first.

EmailAddress.description: An email address with an optional display name (RFC 8621 §4.1.2).

name.description: Display name, or null if none.

AddressWithParameters.description: SMTP envelope address with optional SMTP parameters (RFC 8621 §7).

Envelope.description: SMTP envelope for an email submission (RFC 8621 §7).

DeliveryStatus.description: Per-recipient delivery status for an EmailSubmission (RFC 8621 §7).

smtpReply.description: The SMTP reply from the server, if received.

delivered.description: Whether the message has been delivered to the recipient's incoming mail server.

displayed.description: Whether the recipient's client has displayed it (from an MDN).

EmailSubmission.description: A JMAP EmailSubmission object (RFC 8621 §7). Records the submission of an Email for delivery.

identityId.description: The identity used to send the email.

threadId.description: The thread the email belongs to (server-set).

envelope.description: SMTP envelope. Null means the server generated it from the email headers.

sendAt.description: The date/time the email was/will be submitted (server-set).

undoStatus.description: Whether the submission can still be cancelled.

dsnBlobIds.description: Blob ids of received DSN messages (server-set).

mdnBlobIds.description: Blob ids of received MDN messages (server-set).

EmailSubmissionCreate.description: Client-settable fields when creating an EmailSubmission (RFC 8621 §7.5).

identityId.description: The identity to send from. Required.

envelope.description: SMTP envelope. If null the server generates it from the email headers.

sendAt.description: Scheduled send time. If null send immediately.

Identity.description: A JMAP Identity object (RFC 8621 §6). Represents a From address the user may send from.

name.description: Display name shown in the From header.

email.description: The email address. Server-set and immutable.

replyTo.description: Reply-To header addresses, or null for none.

bcc.description: Bcc header addresses added to all outgoing emails, or null for none.

textSignature.description: Plain-text signature appended to outgoing emails.

htmlSignature.description: HTML signature appended to outgoing emails.

mayDelete.description: Whether the user may delete this identity (server-set).

IdentityUpdate.description: Client-settable fields when updating an Identity (RFC 8621 §6.2). Users cannot change email, id, or mayDelete.

name.description: Display name shown in the From header.

replyTo.description: Reply-To header addresses, or null to remove.

bcc.description: Bcc addresses added to all outgoing emails, or null to remove.

textSignature.description: Plain-text signature appended to outgoing emails.

htmlSignature.description: HTML signature appended to outgoing emails.

MailboxCreate.description: Client-settable fields when creating a Mailbox (RFC 8621 §3.5).

parentId.description: Parent mailbox id, or null for top-level.

role.description: System role (inbox, trash, etc.), or null.

MailboxUpdate.description: Client-settable fields when updating a Mailbox (RFC 8621 §3.5). Delivered as a PatchObject in practice.

name.description: New user-visible name for the mailbox.

parentId.description: New parent mailbox id, or null to move to top-level.

ImportEmailObject.description: A single email to import via Email/import (RFC 8621 §5.4).

blobId.description: Blob id of the raw RFC 5322 message to import.

mailboxIds.description: Id[Boolean] map — MailboxId → true. At least one entry required (RFC 8621 §4.8).

keywords.description: Initial keywords to set on the email.

receivedAt.description: Override for the receivedAt date. If null the server uses the current time.
